plan.summary: This 4-week block starts the 12-week off-camp build for boxing with one focused full-body session each week. Week 1 establishes simple movement baselines with bodyweight assessment-style top efforts where useful, and the main training begins in Week 2. Because equipment is bodyweight only and weekly lifting frequency is low, the plan emphasizes explosive intent, controlled strength work, trunk strength, and short conditioning that supports boxing without creating excess soreness.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic full-body strength, jumping and throwing intent without equipment, and repeatable conditioning with clean movement quality.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress unilateral strength, explosive output, and conditioning density while keeping recovery manageable around boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in place and express faster, sharper bodyweight power and conditioning with less fatigue.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump as high as you can on every rep. Stick the landing softly and rest enough to keep each jump crisp.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if space is tight. Start still at the bottom and drive straight up fast.

substitutionOptions.name: Low Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low stable box only if landing mechanics are clean and confident.

exercises.name: 2. Push-Up
exercises.reps: Max clean reps stopping 1 rep before form breaks
exercises.notes: This set establishes your current upper-body strength baseline. Use a straight body line, lower under control, and stop before your hips sag or range shortens.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up with a few easy sets, then perform one hard top set of clean reps and log the total. This gives a starting baseline for future progress.

performanceTarget.prompt: Beat this clean-rep baseline over time with better quality first, then more reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use hands on a bench, table, or box if full push-ups are not yet consistent.

substitutionOptions.name: Knee Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this only if no sturdy incline is available. Keep torso rigid and full range.

exercises.name: 3. Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use a slow lower and a strong drive up. Keep front foot flat and finish each side with 2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Good option if split-squat setup feels awkward. Step back softly and stay balanced.

substitutionOptions.name: Sit-to-Stand Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a chair or box if leg strength or balance is limited.

exercises.name: 4. Pike Push-Up
exercises.notes: Shift some load onto the shoulders. Move under control and stop with 1-2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the pike position is too demanding on shoulders or hamstrings.

substitutionOptions.name: Wall Handstand Hold
substitutionOptions.notes: Use short controlled holds if pressing reps are not yet smooth.

exercises.name: 5. Side Plank
exercises.notes: Keep ribs down, hips high, and body in a straight line. Build tension, do not just hang.

substitutionOptions.name: Front Plank
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if side planks are too shaky. Brace hard and keep glutes on.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only if plank positions cause discomfort. Move slowly and keep the low back quiet.

exercises.name: 6. Mountain Climber Conditioning
exercises.notes: Fast feet with tight posture. Keep shoulders stacked over hands and do not let the hips bounce.

endurancePrescription.intensity: Moderately hard, smooth breathing, clean pace throughout.

substitutionOptions.name: High-Knee Run in Place
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if wrists do not like floor support. Keep posture tall and arms active.

substitutionOptions.name: Shadowboxing Tempo Rounds
substitutionOptions.notes: Work at a steady pace with light footwork and clean punches if you want a more boxing-specific option.

exercises.name: 1b. Push-Up

performanceTarget.prompt: Track your best clean set at the target range and add reps before making the variation harder.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up

exercises.name: 2. Split Squat

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Good swap if knees feel better stepping back.

substitutionOptions.name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only if you already move well and can keep balance clean.

exercises.name: 3. Pike Push-Up
exercises.notes: Keep elbows tracking naturally and head moving toward the floor in front of the hands. Leave 1-2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if shoulder loading is too high.

substitutionOptions.name: Downward Dog Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a shorter range if full pike reps are not yet strong.

exercises.name: 4. Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.notes: Drive through the heel and pause for a count at the top. Keep hips level side to side.

substitutionOptions.name: Two-Leg Glute Bridge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if single-leg control is not ready yet.

substitutionOptions.name: Hamstring Walkout
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want more posterior-chain challenge and can keep hips up.

exercises.name: 5. Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Flatten the low back gently into the floor and keep the ribs down. Shorten the lever if you lose position.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if the hollow hold is too demanding.

substitutionOptions.name: Front Plank
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if floor position or hip flexors do not tolerate hollow work well.

exercises.name: 6. Shadowboxing Conditioning
exercises.notes: Work at a steady but purposeful pace. Keep hands up, feet active, and breathe through the whole round.

endurancePrescription.intensity: Moderately hard. Clean output, not all-out.

substitutionOptions.name: High-Knee Run in Place
